children: Rossell Techsys reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue and profitability in the second quarter of FY27, with revenue from operations rising 48 per cent year-on-year to Rs 185.5 crore, compared with Rs 125.3 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.

The Bengaluru-based aerospace and defence engineering and manufacturing company recorded a Profit Before Tax (PBT) of Rs 12.7 crore in Q2 FY27, an increase of 89 per cent year-on-year. It marked the first time the company reported double-digit quarterly PBT.
Profit After Tax (PAT) increased to Rs 9.4 crore from Rs 5 crore in Q2 FY26, while earnings per share rose to Rs 2.50 from Rs 1.33.
The company attributed its performance to continued order inflows, expansion into the semiconductor equipment segment and investments in manufacturing infrastructure.
Rs 430 Crore In Orders During H1

Rossell Techsys secured new orders worth approximately Rs 430 crore during the first half of FY27, reflecting business momentum across its established aerospace and defence operations and emerging segments.
Of this, around Rs 190 crore in orders were received during the second quarter. The company also submitted bids worth nearly Rs 1,000 crore during the quarter.
Its overall bid pipeline stands at approximately Rs 1,350 crore across aerospace and defence, semiconductor and industrial segments.
The company also onboarded another leading global semiconductor equipment original equipment manufacturer (OEM), strengthening its presence in the semiconductor manufacturing supply chain.

Rossell Techsys is looking to expand its participation in the semiconductor sector amid rising demand for advanced computing infrastructure and manufacturing equipment, driven partly by the growth of artificial intelligence.
For the half year ended 30 September 2026, Rossell Techsys reported standalone revenue from operations of Rs 340.19 crore, registering a 60 per cent increase from Rs 212.24 crore in H1 FY26.
PBT increased to Rs 22.27 crore from Rs 10.71 crore in the corresponding period last year, while PAT stood at Rs 16.40 crore. Earnings per share for the first half rose to Rs 4.35 from Rs 2.12.
Commenting on the results, Rishab Gupta, Managing Director of Rossell Techsys, said the company had recorded its highest-ever quarterly revenue and its first double-digit quarterly PBT.

He said the company had secured approximately Rs 430 crore in orders during the first half and had a bid pipeline of Rs 1,350 crore, providing opportunities across aerospace, defence, semiconductor and industrial markets.

Chief Executive Officer Senthil Bala said the company would continue investing in manufacturing infrastructure, workforce development and engineering capabilities to support the growing complexity and scale of customer programmes.

Rossell Techsys specialises in design, custom engineering, manufacturing and lifecycle support for the aerospace, defence and adjacent industries. The company is also expanding its presence in semiconductor, space and industrial segments.
